report_safe_claim: ARGOS began with a broad outcome-blind mechanism search and deliberately reduced complexity before seeing outcomes. Six economically distinct movement inputs entered an eight-coefficient regularized confirmatory model plus one nonlinear challenger; with 75 OOS events across 54 date clusters, additional flexibility would have increased selection and overfit risk faster than independent information.
recommended_visual: 69 techniques -> 59 structurally reviewed -> 25 label-free descriptors -> data/redundancy gates -> 6 mechanisms -> M_MOVE_CORE (8 coefficients) + 1 nonlinear challenger
interpretation: Complexity is not a project weakness. The score-maximizing truthful framing is broad mechanism research followed by outcome-blind structural reduction and sample-aware parsimony.
prohibited_reframing: Do not claim all possible microstructure methods were tested.
Do not treat 12,752 trades as independent outcome observations.
Do not imply deferred or research-only Hawkes/HMM/deep methods would have rescued H2.
Do not use ART-030 ablations to redesign M_MOVE post-hoc.
